final_message:
DONE

I've built the nine-slide October 2025 report, but I couldn't render it because no slide renderer is installed here. Layout was checked only by calculating positions and confirming nothing runs off the slide. Please open it and look for any text that overflows, especially on the Gantt chart (slide 4), the spend slide (5) and the risk table (6).

Files in `outputs/`:
- `BridgeMind_AI_Monthly_Project_Report_October_2025.pptx`

The `workspace/` and `attachments/` folders were empty, so I used only the four reference files. Slide 4 is a Gantt built from the workbook's plan shading. Slide 5 has a spend table and a native chart. Speaker notes on every slide give sources and assumptions.

**Headline position**
- **Delivery:** on schedule. Work package 1 ends with Output 1, due 7 Nov, and the log records no open issues.
- **Spend:** £10,298.70 of £29,623.10 (34.8%) at one third of the time. That is £424.33 above an even six-month profile, down from £1,044.17 above after month 1. Remaining budget is £19,324.40.
- **Risk:** four risks, none rated High after mitigation. I left all ratings unchanged because no revised register was provided.

**Data problems I flagged in the deck rather than hiding**
- **Output 1 dates conflict.** The 27 Oct log has stakeholder comments finalised by 9 Nov (a Sunday), after the 7 Nov hand-over to Professor Dodge. No decision is recorded, so I put it on slide 7 and in the Q&A prompts as a question.
- **Spend figures post-date the report.** The spend workbook is dated 3 Nov and covers the week of 27 Oct, so I labelled the figures provisional as at 30 Oct.
- **Overhead label doesn't reconcile.** The workbook says "6826.5/6", but the £1,139.35 monthly charge times six is £6,836.10, which is 30% of direct costs. I used the calculated values.
- **One workbook sheet contradicts the rest.** The "4.0 CURRENT PROJECT COSTS" sheet (total £9,733.10) disagrees with the weekly burn profile and the days used, so I didn't use it.
- **Later months aren't forecasts.** Months 3 onward in the workbook show overhead only, so their apparent "underspend" is not a forecast. The workbook holds no forecast to complete, and I didn't invent one.
- **Risk register gaps.** The SpinBits data concern is logged under Risk 4, though it also bears on data availability (Risks 1 and 3). The register has no owner, date or status fields, so I suggested a register review.
- **A log date looks wrong.** The 13 Oct log entry refers to a 15 Oct meeting, which is in the future. I noted it for confirmation.

I added no extra slides beyond the nine you specified.
